anomalies.description: A motorcycle lies on its side in the middle of the road after a collision; a silver SUV is stopped nearby with its driver's door open, and a person in dark clothing is seen getting out and approaching the motorcycle between frames f5 and f8.

After the crash, a person exits the SUV (visible from f5 onward) and approaches the fallen motorcyclist; in frames f7–f8, the person leans over the motorcycle and appears to interact aggressively with the rider on the ground, consistent with attacking a helpless victim.
The dashcam vehicle collides with a white van entering from the left at an intersection; the impact causes severe camera shake and windshield distortion visible in subsequent frames.

A silver sedan is seen mid-collision or immediately post-collision, angled across the road with visible damage and smoke/vapor emitting from its front left side; a blue car is overturned on the grassy shoulder to the right, indicating a recent crash involving at least two vehicles.

A severe vehicle crash is visible on the right shoulder of the road, with a heavily damaged truck and debris scattered across the roadside; the scene is static across frames, indicating the accident has already occurred.
